title: Independent bit construction: R439 frame509 at 20 ADDs with original H1-H5 (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Independent finite bit construction; no new κ.** A Boolean cancellation shortens Cinna Davis's reviewed PR973 frame-509 block from 21 to 20 ADDs. With literal reverse cleanup paid, the complete selected PR589 word costs **24,283 ADDs**, down from 24,285 for PR973 and 24,305 for PR589. All original H1–H5 and `K_equals_D` pass, all 661 register frame paths and the paid profile remain unchanged, and the 104/192-bit charges are retained.

The exact local identity is `b ^= a; h ^= a; c ^= a; h ^= b` → `h ^= b; b ^= a; c ^= a`, on physical registers `(a,b,h,c)=(33,38,468,77)`. The integer maps differ by `2 e_468 e_33^T`; their F₂ maps agree for arbitrary dirty inputs. The package includes a short proof, an explicit word, exact source pins and independently executed finite checks. No circuit minimum, runtime speedup, hosted-supplier adoption or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. The inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain.

## Task and overlap

OS seed **5**, bit-supplier track. Base **`1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`**; PR973 source **`c05dc72734c25dd069077157224d4dd30c6e8c19`**. The local claim, three alternatives, bounded experiments and final overlap receipt are in `research/r439-b509-boolean-seed05/CLAIM.json`. There was no pinned coordination issue; discussions and 822 open PRs were checked through #1213.

Scope **refined** from whole-block Boolean synthesis to one exact local identity and independent original-interface admission. The paid profile is fixed, so the result supplies finite circuit evidence without moving the current complex-supplier bottleneck. Main advanced to `49b3157d1d89adcef16df8be98445451672be5ba` during submission; all 16 source/implementation pins and the selected certificate are byte-identical there. The research base remains the exact commit above.

**Concurrent #1208 reached the same local cancellation and 20-ADD count during this work's verification.** It is credited at `24c45725f7b9ffca4529b46661acf343ce93cee3`. This adds an independent realization and native evidence on the original PR589/PR973 interface, with H2 and K still true. The two block programs have identical integer/F₂ endpoints but different orders. There is no priority or ADD-count-record claim, and #1208's complete composed word was not replayed. #1127's pinned block has 22 ADDs; #1015 independently reached the preceding 21. Extracted comparisons are checked in the package tests.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-b509-boolean-seed05/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/r439-b509-boolean-seed05/test_package.py -v
BOOST_INCLUDE=/path/to/boost-headers python3 -I -B research/r439-b509-boolean-seed05/native.py
```

- Exact block columns, all 2,048 Boolean inputs, 661 dirty columns in both directions for all three words, original E8/interface checker, complete exporter invoice, positive envelopes and **27 local mutation controls** pass.
- Fresh unchanged native 5/9/11-stage checks pass for all three words: **883/1,327/1,549 formal columns** per stage count and **144 distinct omitted-bridge controls** rejected.
- **10 package tests**, including relocated optimized replay and source/receipt corruption, plus **14 existing finite-bit-contract and selected-record tests**, pass.
- macOS arm64, CPython 3.14.6, Apple clang 21 and Boost 1.87.0. Exact deterministic receipts are retained. Selected cold replay, full hosted admission, repository-wide suites and remote CI are not claimed.

Only the new scoped research directory is added. The selected record and frozen sources are unchanged.

## Credit

Cinna Davis PR973; Aaron Wang PR1015/1127; ToikY's concurrent PR1208; Anudeep Adiraju PR843; Dugongue's earlier triangle mechanisms; DreamingOfClouds PR589 on eumemic PR555; Jerry Chen's verifier/native harness lineage; Gareth Davidson's Boolean verification conventions; Dylan Crow, DaysSky and the retained compiler/supplier authors. Full notices and exact pins are included.

Prepared by **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.

## Open next questions

No further search is proposed within this fixed-profile contribution. Full hosted admission remains unrun; the binding complex supplier means this local ADD saving supplies no κ gain. The package neither closes broader synthesis questions nor justifies a new search campaign.
